item.title: Tree roots pushing up through tarmac, 7th August
item.description:
The tarmac is cracked and raised and is a trip hazard. These were reported in around 2021 and were repaired at that time. However the roots are now breaking through the tarmac again. There is no street light on that side of the road and the trees create shadows that make it very dark at night, and not clearly visible. They are on the pavement across the road from No. 9 Annandale Road, DA15.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 2, Beverley Avenue, Blackfen, Sidcup, Greater London

item.title: Road works at footscray, 7th August
item.description:
The roadworks at Footscray by Thames water are causing sidcup to come to a stand still ! They have already taken over Chislehurst Road for long term works ( into 2027) and now they've started works at these traffic lights ! It took me half an hour to get from the top of Sidcup hill to the bottom - a journey that would normally take 10 minutes ! I am a frequent visitor to this area and was unaware of any water issues ( I'm usually the one that reports them!)

item.title: Bird fouling covering children’s play equipment, 7th August
item.description:
The children’s playground at Victory Community Park, Balfour Street, SE17 1PL, is heavily contaminated with bird droppings. The enclosed tunnel and surrounding wooden play surfaces are covered in faeces. Children must touch and crawl through these areas, so this is a hygiene and health concern. Please arrange urgent cleaning and consider measures to prevent the problem recurring.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Elba Place, Walworth, Greater London
